title: Commerce NSTC Operator and Natcast Agreement Action
summary: Commerce announced that NIST would assume operational responsibility for the NSTC and stated that the prior agreement granting Natcast up to $7.4 billion was invalid.
key_findings: NIST was assigned operational responsibility for the NSTC effective immediately.
Commerce said it would not abide by the prior up-to-$7.4-billion Natcast agreement.
The release did not publish a recipient-by-recipient disposition of the earlier NAPMP and facility commitments.
why_it_matters: Implementation evidence must preserve reversals and governance changes. The later action prevents the earlier Natcast award and facility narrative from being treated as an unbroken funding trail.
ftfn_relevance: Adds a material program-governance discontinuity to the advanced-packaging record.
Creates revalidation gates for every operator, award, payment, facility, and procurement claim.
evidence_limits: The source's legal characterization is Commerce's official position, not an independent judicial finding.
The release does not establish the disposition of every individual award, contract, payment, facility, employee, or research activity.
